t:
(a) During the current fiscal year, the civilian personnel of the Department of Defense may not be managed on the basis of any end-strength, and the management of such personnel during that fiscal year shall not be subject to any constraint or limitation (known as an end-strength) on the number of such personnel who may be employed on the last day of such fiscal year. 
    (b) The fiscal year 2021 budget request for the Department of Defense as well as all justification material and other documentation supporting the fiscal year 2021 Department of Defense budget request shall be prepared and submitted to the Congress as if subsections (a) and (b) of this provision were effective with regard to fiscal year 2021. 
    (c) As required by section 1107 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2014 (Public Law 113–66; 10 U.S.C. 2358 note) civilian personnel at the Department of Army Science and Technology Reinvention Laboratories may not be managed on the basis of the Table of Distribution and Allowances, and the management of the workforce strength shall be done in a manner consistent with the budget available with respect to such Laboratories. 
    (d) Nothing in this section shall be construed to apply to military (civilian) technicians.

fable.w: The section governs internal management of Department of Defense civilian personnel and requires that budget materials be submitted to Congress. The tempting reading is that the submission to Congress is a form of consultation, but Congress is inside the federal government, so this does not cross the federal boundary. No outside party such as a state, the public, experts, or companies is consulted or given any role in a federal decision.
fable.s: shall be prepared and submitted to the Congress as if subsections (a) and (b) of this provision were effective with regard to fiscal year 2021

qwen_block.w: This section mandates that budget requests and documentation be submitted to Congress. Congress is part of the federal government, so reporting to it is an internal government action, not participation by outside parties. The section also describes internal personnel management rules for the Department of Defense, which does not involve consultation with or input from non-federal entities.
qwen_block.s: The fiscal year 2021 budget request for the Department of Defense as well as all justification material and other documentation supporting the fiscal year 2021 Department of Defense budget request shall be prepared and submitted to the Congress as if subsections (a) and (b) of this provision were effective with regard to fiscal year 2021.

opus.w: The section sets internal rules for managing Department of Defense civilian staff (no end-strength limits, no management by the Table of Distribution and Allowances) and says how the budget request must be prepared for Congress. Sending the budget to Congress might look procedural, but it is a submission from one part of the federal government to another. No states, experts, companies, or members of the public are consulted, and there is no comment period, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue.
opus.s: shall be prepared and submitted to the Congress as if subsections (a) and (b) of this provision were effective with regard to fiscal year 2021
opus.b: The tempting reading is that subsection (b) counts as participation because the budget request must be "submitted to the Congress." That fails because Congress is inside the federal government. Nothing else in the section brings in anyone from outside the government.

qwen_chat.w: This section deals with internal personnel management within the Department of Defense and the submission of budget requests to Congress. Congress is part of the federal government, so interactions with it do not constitute participation by outside parties. There is no requirement to consult with states, tribes, the public, or other non-federal entities.
qwen_chat.s: The fiscal year 2021 budget request for the Department of Defense as well as all justification material and other documentation supporting the fiscal year 2021 Department of Defense budget request shall be prepared and submitted to the Congress as if subsections (a) and (b) of this provision were effective with regard to fiscal year 2021.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because the budget request is submitted to Congress, this involves participation. However, Congress is inside the federal government, so reporting to or submitting budgets to Congress is not "participation" under the definition. Another potential trap is the mention of "civilian personnel," but these are federal employees, not outside parties. The section describes internal management rules and reporting requirements within the executive branch and to Congress. There is no consultation with states, tribes, the public, or other non-federal entities.
